verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a local and cloud model runner, but the evidence pack documents no export of user data, chats, or models in open formats. The local-privacy claims say data stays on the machine, which is not an export capability. One community comment alleges lock-in through a proprietary registry format with hashed filenames, which reinforces the absence of a documented export path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
